title: Surreal Apocalypse Bloom
description: A divided digital painting featuring a dramatic upper landscape with a dark ruined tower under stormy clouds on the left, a glowing green and yellow planet, icy mountains, and large luminous purple lotus flowers with fiery centers. The lower half shows a bloodied young woman with long red hair and a facial scar on the left, a blue and purple snake coiled around a lotus, and a stylized portrait of a woman with pink hair and blue eyes on the right.
